description: The realised-yield market index: per asset class (stable, eth, btc, other) and week, the median and 90th percentile of the realised 30-day rate across comparable vaults of $1M or more, with n the vaults behind each point. A point under three vaults keeps its n and has null figures. Today’s comparable vaults traced back as far as our share-price history reaches (`publishedFrom` per class); early points rest on weekly readings and few vaults. FREE.
